AWS Storage Gateway solves the other job in this area, giving on-premises applications a cached path to cloud storage.

distractors.B: A hybrid storage path extends on-premises applications into the cloud; it does not set or prove backup retention.
distractors.C: Object lifecycle rules govern objects in a bucket, so they are a real mechanism at the wrong layer for volume and database backups.
distractors.D: Retention settings and the evidence that they were met stay with the customer even where a service performs backups for it.

questions.question: A uniform embroidery supplier receives scanned order forms as email attachments and wants the customer name, garment size, and quantity lifted out of each scan automatically. Its two developers have no machine learning experience and no labeled training data of their own. Which service fits?

options.A: Amazon SageMaker AI, used to build and train a model on the supplier's own scans
options.B: Amazon Rekognition, whose image analysis identifies the objects present in a scan
options.C: Amazon Textract, which extracts text and form fields from scanned documents
options.D: Amazon Transcribe, which turns the content of each order form into written text

rationale.correct: The AWS AI/ML services split between ready-made capabilities and a platform for building your own. Pulling text and form fields out of a scanned document is a ready-made capability, so no model has to be trained and no labeled data is needed - which matters for a team with neither.

distractors.A: Amazon SageMaker AI is the build-your-own platform, so it asks the supplier for exactly the skills and training data it does not have.
distractors.B: Amazon Rekognition analyzes images for objects, scenes, and faces, which is a different question from reading the fields on a form.
distractors.D: Amazon Transcribe converts speech to text, and an order form arriving as a scan carries no audio.

questions.question: An adventure tour operator already keeps several years of booking exports as files in Amazon S3. Its finance analyst wants to answer occasional one-off questions about them in SQL, without loading the files into a database and without operating a cluster. Which service does that?

options.A: AWS Glue, which prepares and catalogs the data before any question is asked
options.B: Amazon Athena, which runs SQL queries directly against the files in Amazon S3
options.C: Amazon Quick Sight, whose dashboards visualize the figures for the finance team
options.D: A relational database the exports are loaded into first and then queried there

rationale.correct: The analytics services are near neighbors doing different jobs. Running SQL straight over files already sitting in object storage, with nothing to provision, is what Amazon Athena is for. AWS Glue prepares and catalogs data, and Amazon Quick Sight presents it once the questions have settled into dashboards.

distractors.A: Data preparation and cataloging support querying; on their own they answer none of the analyst's questions.
distractors.C: Dashboards suit figures watched repeatedly, and the analyst described occasional one-off questions instead.
distractors.D: Loading years of exports into a database is a project in itself, which is the work the analyst asked to avoid.

questions.question: A campus shuttle service wants two things when a shuttle is delayed: the ticketing system should hand the delay to a slower refund component without waiting for it, and the same delay should reach the rider app, the platform signs, and the operations inbox together. Which TWO services deliver these? (Select TWO.)

options.A: Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS), holding the delay for the refund component
options.B: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS), fanning the delay out to every channel
options.C: AWS Step Functions, orchestrating the delay handling as a multi-step workflow
options.D: Amazon Connect, which reaches riders through the service's cloud contact center
options.E: A shared database table that each component polls every minute for new delays

rationale.correct: The application-integration services are chosen by delivery shape. A queue decouples a fast producer from a slow consumer, holding each delay until the refund component is ready for it. A notification topic fans one message out to many subscribers at once, which is what puts the same delay in front of the app, the signs, and the inbox together.

distractors.C: Step Functions sequences a multi-step process with visible state, and neither of these needs are a workflow with steps.
distractors.D: A cloud contact center serves voice and chat conversations with people, not message delivery between systems.
distractors.E: Polling a table on a schedule builds a delay into every notification and still leaves the components coupled to one store.

questions.question: A city zoning department's permit application sends tens of thousands of status emails to applicants each month, and receiving providers have begun blocking its self-run mail relay. The department wants the application itself to send those messages dependably at that volume. Which service fits?

options.A: Amazon Connect, the cloud contact center the department can route the messages through
options.B: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics that applicants subscribe to one by one
options.C: Amazon EventBridge, which routes each status change straight to the applicant's mail provider
options.D: Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES), built for application-sent email at scale

rationale.correct: The business-application services meet needs the messaging services do not. Sending large volumes of email from an application, with the deliverability work that goes with it, is exactly what the email service exists for, which is what a blocked self-run relay needs replaced.

distractors.A: Amazon Connect runs a contact center for voice and chat conversations with people; it is not a bulk email sender.
distractors.B: Topic subscriptions expect subscribers to opt in, which does not match applicants who are emailed about their own permit.
distractors.C: An event bus routes events between AWS targets; it does not deliver mail to an external provider on its own.

questions.question: A coffee equipment importer's order service has started answering slowly, and nobody can say which of the several internal calls behind each order is responsible. Builds and releases are running normally, and the last deployment was weeks ago. Which service helps find the slow call?

options.A: AWS CodeBuild, which compiles and tests the service so the fault is caught in the build
options.B: AWS CodePipeline, which sequences the release stages the service moves through
options.C: AWS X-Ray, which traces a request through the service and times each call it makes
options.D: A rollback of the last release, returning the service to its earlier behavior

rationale.correct: Developer tools sit at different lifecycle stages: build and test, then release sequencing, then troubleshooting what is already running. Tracing a request end to end and timing each call it makes belongs to the troubleshooting stage, which is where a service that has started answering slowly needs help.

distractors.A: Building and testing happen before the code ships, and a service already slow in production is past that stage.
distractors.B: Release sequencing moves code through its stages; the importer's releases are working and are not what is being diagnosed.
distractors.D: Undoing a release weeks old is an intervention chosen before the cause is known, and it may leave the slow call untouched.

questions.question: A cold-chain trucking fleet hires seasonal dispatchers who work from their own laptops. Each dispatcher needs a full desktop carrying the fleet's applications, and their settings and working files must still be there at the start of the next shift. Which service provides that?

options.A: Amazon WorkSpaces, which gives each dispatcher a persistent virtual desktop
options.B: Amazon AppStream 2.0, which streams individual applications to a dispatcher's laptop
options.C: Amazon WorkSpaces Secure Browser, which delivers controlled access to web applications
options.D: Amazon EC2 instances the dispatchers reach with one set of credentials shared per shift

rationale.correct: The end-user-computing services differ in what they present. A persistent virtual desktop gives each dispatcher a whole environment that survives sign-out, which is what carrying settings and files between shifts requires. Streaming one application and delivering a controlled browser session present less than a desktop by design.

distractors.B: Streaming individual applications covers the fleet's software and not the desktop around it that holds a dispatcher's working state.
distractors.C: A controlled browser session reaches web applications only, and it is built to leave nothing behind at the end of a session.
distractors.D: Raw instances with credentials shared across a shift give every seasonal dispatcher the same identity and no attribution.

questions.question: An art print marketplace has fitted humidity sensors in each partner gallery to protect the works on display. The sensors must connect securely, report readings continuously, and be managed as one growing fleet as galleries join. Which service is purpose-built for this?

options.A: AWS Amplify, used to create and deploy the frontend the galleries will look at
options.B: AWS IoT Core, which connects and manages the sensor fleet as it grows
options.C: Amazon EC2 instances running a message broker the marketplace builds itself
options.D: Amazon Kinesis, which ingests the stream of readings the sensors produce

rationale.correct: Purpose-built services exist for exactly these workloads. Connecting devices securely, taking their readings, and managing them as a fleet is the job of the IoT service, which is why the marketplace does not have to assemble it. AWS Amplify covers the other half of this category, creating and deploying frontend and mobile services.

distractors.A: A frontend service builds what people look at; the galleries' problem is getting sensors connected and managed in the first place.
distractors.C: A self-built broker on instances is assembly work that reproduces device connectivity and fleet management by hand.
distractors.D: Stream ingestion handles readings once they arrive, and it does not connect or manage the devices sending them.
